info.desc: Interactive chat feature for resume creation assistant with mobile-optimized layout and full-screen preview panel
info.tech: React, TypeScript, Material-UI, Custom Hooks, Responsive Design

chat_feature.folder_structure: /features/chat ├── components/ # Chat UI components │ ├── ChatWindow.tsx # Main chat container │ ├── ChatMessage.tsx # Individual message component │ ├── ChatInput.tsx # Message input component │ └── index.ts # Component exports ├── hooks/ # Custom hooks for chat logic │ └── useChat.ts # Main chat hook with state management ├── services/ # API services │ └── chatApi.ts # Chat API with mock implementation ├── types/ # TypeScript interfaces │ └── chat.ts # Chat message and API types ├── ChatPage.tsx # Main chat page with responsive layout and full-screen preview panel └── pages/ # Chat pages └── MainDialogPage.tsx # Main dialog page with progress bar

feature.name: preview_panel
feature.flow: 1. User sees chat interface by default on mobile 2. Hamburger menu button (three lines) appears in top-right corner 3. User clicks button to open full-screen preview panel 4. Panel slides in from right with smooth animation 5. Panel shows "Resume Preview" header with close button 6. Larger resume preview is displayed in panel 7. User can close panel with X button 8. Panel slides out to the right

feature.name: message_sending
feature.desc: Send user messages and receive AI responses
feature.flow: 1. User types message in ChatInput 2. Message appears immediately in chat 3. Placeholder assistant message shows with loading animation 4. API call is made to chatApi (mock implementation) 5. Assistant response replaces placeholder message

feature.name: loading_states
feature.states: - Loading spinner in assistant messages - Disabled input during processing - "Thinking..." text during API call

feature.name: mock_api
feature.implementation: - Random response selection from predefined messages - Simulated network delay (1-3 seconds) - Error handling for failed requests
